title: Japanese-Style Steamed Egg Custard (Chawanmushi)
description: A traditional Japanese dish made with steamed egg custard, typically served as a side or light meal. This version is infused with the flavors of coriander and served in a delicate cup.
instructions: Combine water, soy sauce, sugar, coriander seeds, and salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add dashi powder and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and mirin.
Strain the dashi mixture into a clean bowl, discarding the solids.
Add the egg mixture to the dashi mixture and whisk until smooth.
Pour the mixture into the chawanmushi cups.
Steam the cups over boiling water for 12-15 minutes, or until the egg is set.
Remove from heat and serve warm.
